concept.internal_detail: miniature phosphor-bronze leaf springs and bevel gears
concept.button: a small knurled copper plunger set flush into the trailing edge
concept.shell_mechanic: The flattened spade plinth unlatches along its lateral margins and the two broad pectoral plates swing outward on hidden pivot pins
concept.emerging_parts: A segmented whip-like tail rod and two small ventral clasper struts
concept.signature_move: its twin bronze pectoral plates flex once in a slow undulating wave and its slender whip tail tilts upward on its base hinge with a soft metallic click
concept.turkish: Vatoz balığı (yassı gövdeli, uzun kuyruklu kıkırdaklı deniz balığı) — yassı kürek kaidesi, oksitlenmiş namlu metali ve fırçalanmış bronz
